confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and are set for July peak season, when Aix's Festival d'Aix and summer tourism raise prices. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate text in search results; I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Provençal tourist city, positioned between Avignon and Marseille for restaurants and between Avignon and Nice for July accommodation. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer relationship: cocktail about 2.3x beer and wine glass about 1.2x beer, because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
